title: The lot at night, empty
logline: The Lanes' lot at night, empty, the sign mostly dark, the alley's mouth beside it where two figures would be. Nobody. The page holds the walk's place open.

panels.composition: A bowling alley's parking lot at night, empty, the neon sign mostly dark above, the mouth of an alley beside the building with no one in it, rain.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, an empty bowling alley parking lot at night beneath a mostly dark neon sign with the mouth of an alley beside the building and no one in it, rain, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
